note: Input rows for the four body sizes. height_m and weight_tons are inputs taken from public fan-wiki figures (height in feet x 0.3048); the weight unit is assumed to be metric tons (the harness reads weight_tons x 1000 kg unless --ton-kg is given). 'verified': true only means the number was read on a public web page, not that the page is an authoritative source. The h182m row (height and weight) is marked as an estimate by its own source.
